index-tagline:

Making the world better through data.
index-success-text: We are not a large consulting firm whose primary goals are long-term, expensive "engagements."
contact-subtitle: We want to hear from you!
about-subtitle: We are a team of web, mobile, and IT software and database developers based in Switzerland and the United States.  Our specialty is collection, analysis, and visualization of global, regional, and country-level health data.  For over a decade, our results have earned us a trusted reputation and excellent client retention rate.  Our customer-centric approach permeates every level of our work, and delivering quality, reasonably-priced results is what we do best.
about-history-text: We started at a time when Excel spreadsheets were the norm for collecting world-wide data.  Our initial project successes quickly spread to other areas with the same business need: web-based, secure data collection with central and regional management of users and surveys.  Just as important was access to response data in multiple formats, notably Stata, Excel, ODBC, and direct data editing of online data.  This is what we do, and we do it well.
services-web-text: Data collection that is intuitive and cost-effective, including document uploads, metadata/footnotes, completeness checks, and multilingual. Secure, responsive design that works on any device and looks great.
services-database-text: Web and mobile platforms provide the input but you need ways to access and export data.  We provide you with the tools to manage data through import templates and real-time data editing.
services-visualization-text: Maps, charts, or business intelligence solutions.  The key is interactivity with the users and effective story-telling.  Make your data beautiful.
